about.title: Certified Personal Trainer
about.bio: I help everyday athletes and fitness beginners alike build the body and habits they want — through proven programming, consistent accountability, and coaching that adapts to your life. No cookie-cutter plans. No guesswork. Just results.

hero.headline: Transform Your Body. Change Your Life.
hero.subline: Private personal training — customized programs, nutrition guidance, and real accountability for clients who are ready to make a lasting change.

packages.title: Kickstart Program
packages.description: A structured 4-week introduction — 3 sessions per week, baseline assessments, nutrition fundamentals, and habit-building. Perfect for clients getting started or returning after a break.

packages.title: Transformation Program
packages.description: The complete 12-week body composition program — 3 sessions per week, progressive overload programming, weekly check-ins, nutrition coaching, and full accountability support.

packages.title: Elite Performance
packages.description: Ongoing monthly training for clients who have completed a transformation program and want to keep progressing — 4 sessions per week, monthly reprogramming, and priority scheduling.

faq.question: Do you offer online training?
faq.answer: Yes — fully remote online training is available with the same programming, check-ins, and accountability as in-person sessions. Great for clients with busy schedules.

faq.question: Do you provide meal plans?
faq.answer: I provide nutrition coaching and macro guidance rather than rigid meal plans — sustainable habits outperform short-term diets every time.

faq.question: I've never worked with a trainer before — where do I start?
faq.answer: Start with the free consult. We'll talk through your goals, training history, and lifestyle so I can recommend the right program for you.

faq.question: Where do in-person sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at a local fitness facility. Exact location is confirmed at booking. Home gym sessions available by arrangement.

faq.question: What if I miss a session?
faq.answer: Life happens. All programs allow for rescheduled sessions with 24-hour notice. I work around your schedule — not the other way around.
